expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. (1) Prohibited vocabulary: it says "expunged" and "immediate expungement" — this is a sealing track, and the IL state pack states that expungement and sealing are not interchangeable; it also says the records were "destroyed", which is expungement language and is asserted of a sealing remedy. (2) Prohibited invention of court identity: court name, county, district, courtroom, docket number, case number, OTN and judge name are filled, and this track collects none of them in screening. (3) Prohibited invention of prosecutor position and outside-party acts: it names the Assistant State's Attorney and asserts "no objection", asserts that service was completed in open court, and asserts counsel's review, adoption and signature — all outside-party acts LegalEase never asserts, and counsel's signature is a required manual completion item. (4) Prohibited hearing outcome: it asserts the judge granted the petition and signs the judge's name on the proposed order, which must be an empty-outcome instrument. (5) Prohibited fee: it states a $136 figure; no statewide fee schedule exists, the source review states no fee for this route, and county fee figures are an open release blocker. (6) Prohibited eligibility conclusion: "Eligible — confirmed" and "the court must grant this petition"; the presiding trial judge rules and no packet asserts a conclusion. (7) Contradicts every screening gate on the track at once: the case was already disposed of three weeks ago (the window is the same hearing), the participant is unrepresented (the route is attorney-mediated under § 5.2(g)(5)(A) and referral is the default), the arrest predates January 1, 2018 (an express exclusion), the dismissal was without prejudice (an express exclusion), and the record type is a conviction rather than an arrest or a charge not initiated by arrest. (8) Prohibited timing statement: "the participant may file at any time after the hearing" inverts the rule and violates the scope restriction against telling the participant they may self-file after leaving court. (9) Prohibited Clean Slate promise: automatic sealing does not begin until January 1, 2029 and the agent must not tell a user their record will be sealed automatically before then. (10) Protected fields populated: date of birth, SSN, state ID, IR number and FBI number must stay blank. (11) Wrong-suite attachments: the Certificate of Service by Circuit Clerk and the Notice of Filing belong to the § 5.2(d) statewide suite, which expressly does not govern this track; service here is a copy handed to the State's Attorney in open court and to no one else.
